entries.text: [EMPTY 33]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_kari_message_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hello, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
Welcome
to
the
Glaseado Gym.
entries.label: gym_koori_040_receptionist_00

entries.text: Do you want to face the Sub-zero Shredder\nhimself, Gym Leader Grusha?
entries.label: gym_koori_040_receptionist_01

entries.text: Very well. Allow me to show you to the\nbattle court.
entries.label: gym_koori_040_receptionist_02

entries.text: Of course. Please feel free to come speak to me\nwhenever you’re ready.
entries.label: gym_koori_040_receptionist_03

entries.text: Bwaaah!
entries.label: gym_koori_040_poke_01

entries.text: There you are![VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_00

entries.text: Brrrrrr... I’m freezing...[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_01

entries.text: ...I take it you’re a challenger?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_02

entries.text: My name’s Grusha. I’m a snowboarder. Used to\nbe pro, actually.\c\nNow I’m a Gym Leader.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_03

entries.text: I saw you on the slopes. Your skills... Yeah, they\nwere pretty cool.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_04

entries.text: But don’t let that go to your head.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_05

entries.text: Winter mountains are dangerous. They can throw\nyour life right off course, easy as that.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_06

entries.text: Same thing with Pokémon battles, really...\nIt’s always the most dangerous when you’re\r\njust starting to get the hang of things.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_07

entries.text: Today’s not a great day to face me, you know...\nYou’re better off giving up.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_08

entries.text: You sure you want to battle me?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_09

entries.text: You bet!
entries.label: gym_koori_040_select_01

entries.text: Uh, I’m not sure now...
entries.label: gym_koori_040_select_02

entries.text: Still tryin’ to act cool, huh? That’s too bad.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_10

entries.text: Nice. Backing off takes its own kind of courage.\nBut I know your type. You always choose to push\r\nforward in the end.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_11

entries.text: Well, this is my job now...so don’t take what\nI’m about to do personally.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_12

entries.text: Get ready to feel the icy bite of reality.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_13

entries.text: That burning passion you have... You strive for\nthe future, no matter what challenges you face.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_14

entries.text: Just like how I used to be...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_15

entries.text: Oh, never mind. I should give you your\nGym Badge.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_16

entries.text: Huh? You want a photo together to\ncommemorate your win...?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_17

entries.text: C-come on, that’s...that’s so uncool.\nI don’t usually do that sort of thing, but...\r\nOK, fine. Special occasion.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_18

entries.text: With [VAR 0x0200(0001)] Gym Badge[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s, you should be able to catch\nPokémon of up to Lv. [VAR 0x0201(0002)] more easily.\c\nThey’ll actually listen to you too, which is nice.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_badge

entries.text: With 8 Gym Badges, you should be able to catch\nPokémon of any level. They’ll also listen to every\r\nword you say, whether it’s cool or not.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_badge_all

entries.text: Oh, and before I forget—you should take\nthis, too.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_waza

entries.text: Should be a lot more useful than some silly\nphoto of you and me...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_19

entries.text: Feel free to stop by again... If you don’t mind the\ncold, that is.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: gym_koori_040_koori_20

entries.text: Congratulations! You’re now certified by the\nGlaseado Gym!
entries.label: gym_koori_040_receptionist_04
